detail.longDescription: I found (and rendered) all these beautiful Fractals with UltraFractal over the years, and although there's a Flickr where you can kinda browse them, I wanted to present them in a more creative way. So, with help from Claude, there are now live-rendered (ported to web) versions of a selection of the fractals on the landing page (that you can zoom yourself if your gpu/cpu are fast enough) and the Android app has access to the full collection as rendered tiles (on an r2 bucket). I'd absolutely love to have some testers from the HN community!
